body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented its 13.3-inch notebook pc 'X360' weighing only 1.27kg during IFA 2008, which is lighter than MacBook Air or Lenovo X300. Powered by Intel Centrino 2 ULV Processor, the X360 features a 13.3-inch wide LED super backlight and 10 hours of battery life(with 6-cell battery).
